notes.title: Player Character Customization Released
notes.notes:
Hello gamers,

I am happy to tell you that Fantasy Dungeon VR is receiving a major update today, including the new player character customization system, many fixes, tweaks.

The new character customization system is available in the right-hand menu. (Right trigger + right menu button)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297060/ae4336949945f36f69c8245a2a9b5f59acc0876c.png[/img]

There are 13 different body modules and 13 attachment types that can be customized to your preference. Please use the <Save&Close> button if you wish the current configuration to be used in future games.

notes.title: Arena Mode Released
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers,

I am happy to tell you that Fantasy Dungeon VR is receiving a major update today, including one new mode, hundreds of fixes, tweaks, balance changes, and optimized game size.

[h2]Arena Mode[/h2]
Arena Mode is available now with a focus on combat. Excluding exploring dungeon rooms from Dungeon Mode, Arena Mode features more intense combat and random shop purchases.

Switch between Arena Mode and Dungeon Mode with the left-hand game menu. (Left trigger + left menu button)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40297060/df949e7b382cf755cef7b1c2a57fee059920db2f.png[/img]
